claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Acetyl-farnesyl-cysteine is a prenylcysteine analog that competitively inhibits isoprenylcysteine carboxyl methyltransferase (ICMT), but at 2.5 uM it is expected to produce little or no cytotoxicity because ICMT inhibition is cytostatic rather than acutely lethal in most cancer lines.
